notes.title: Debut Festival 2025 and a major update
notes.content: [p]The 2025 Debut Festival has just begun. Worlds Explorers is participating! [/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate, I've released this update. [/p][p]I've heavily reworked all the UI panels, improved many graphical elements, improved and added new sounds, and added numerous animations to the game (mainly for weapons, but also for some equipments and cutting trees). There are also some more minor changes.[/p][p]A cat has also started wandering around the ship - and you can pet it![/p][p][/p][p]You can see the new version of the game in the trailer, animations, and screenshots on the Steam page.[/p]

notes.title: Working on a major update
notes.content: [p]I’m currently working on a major update for the game. It includes, among other things, a redesigned UI (including new elements), adding animations to combat and many weapons as well as some inventory items, adding new items, and also improvements and new sounds for the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Next month, I’ll update the Steam page (trailer, animations, screenshots) with these and many other elements.[/p][p][/p][p]Below are some sample animations I’m working on:[/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224985/b9ef0fc6a24a6a8aacd0b601484c4a4e739b0d9e.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224985/ce7cec3b17c74985b5f773d073e6f11f5d30d573.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224985/e1458beff9cae03d0218eeab075b9c9c271fdf41.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224985/5557d2a102eb578cbabe493f9d57c00b787d0cc0.gif"][/img][/carousel]

notes.title: Visual overhaul: hands, shadows & space ships Update
notes.content:
Continued development of the game.
Hands have been added to characters and aliens, along with related animations. Shadows for many elements have been improved, as well as some graphics and effects. Perspective has been improved on ships, and their appearance has been enhanced. Certain UI elements have been improved, along with the behavior of aliens and animals. Minor fixes to various other elements.
The trailer, screenshots and gifs have been updated to the latest version of the game.

notes.title: New UI, devices rework and City Builder & Colony Sim Fest
notes.content:
I have finished reworking some of the UI panels. New resource panel is less overwhelming and allows us to hide what we do not need. New equipment panel is nicer and clearer.

The appearance of ship devices has been reworked to maintain a consistent perspective and look better. Additional minor fixes to other things are done.

And I am happy to announce that Worlds Explorers is now participating in "City Builder & Colony Sim Fest" as an upcoming game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224985/0477f9246da0b045a9b2de177d99f500deeb8242.png[/img]

notes.title: Further work on the graphics completed
notes.content:
Further development work on the game. Many graphical fixes and additional systems that improve the quality of the game's visuals.
The trailer and screenshots have been updated to the latest version of the game.

notes.title: Working on new content and rebuilding the targeting system
notes.content:
Short update - I continue to work on new content and improvements to the systems in the game.

Recently I reworked the aiming system to be more precise and adapting to each weapon. Below you can also see a new weapon and a new animal on one of the planets.

[img]https://shared.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3133600/extras/flamethrower.gif?t=1737221493[/img]

notes.title: Graphics rework completed
notes.content:
After more than 2 months since the Steam page was created, I have finished reworking the game's graphic style. It was a time of intense work, during which I learned a lot of new things about graphics.

Thanks to your feedback and advice, I managed to significantly improve the visual style of the game. Although it is not the final version yet, it is an important step in the development of Worlds Explorers.

Of course, as the game continues to develop, I will continue to improve every aspect of it, including the graphics. Right now, I want to focus on polishing the current version of the game and finishing the mechanics needed to launch Playtests next year.

notes.title: I hear your feedback - working on graphics
notes.content:
Just two days ago I created a Steam Page and I have already received a lot of feedback from you. You are interested in the game, but the main problems you point out are the quality of in-game graphics.

For this reason, I decided to focus on this aspect in the near future. I will try various improvements to the style and quality of graphics to achieve the best effect. While I don't want to completely change the overall style and feel of the game, it could definitely do with a major overhaul.

It will take some time - I will publish a new graphic when I manage to achieve a satisfactory effect.
